title: How to Clone a Menu
text:
## How to Clone a Menu
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000077000
In this article, cloning or copying a menu is explained.
First, navigate to Toolbox >> Menu Manager .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180238740/original/CoJMD_kXIuNs-nbBA0qSmLWXPo8JhcSBXg.png?1781150458 | alt: ]
This area is divided into two sections: Custom Menus appear at the top, and Default Menus appear at the bottom. To clone a menu, a default menu must first be customized.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180238821/original/d1q2R2ZDtRTEIMXJ49bOp1sHYeA5z0ZPsA.png?1781150496 | alt: ]
After a default menu is customized, it will appear in the Custom Menus section. To clone this newly customized menu, click Clone from the Actions dropdown.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180238863/original/QOJ1l4FlZyzi-dt1qEvczRn3jH3COR55hA.png?1781150636 | alt: ]
A confirmation pop-up will appear.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180238865/original/zszc81UIQQGkzNp5BCpNNE1U_0g0qXHBJA.png?1781150668 | alt: ]
After confirmation, the newly cloned menu will appear in the Custom Menus section with a unique menu name and shortcode.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180238891/original/_ePZ2t1D1NNYaigETq_fy5cm1EqHeHVctg.png?1781150705 | alt: ]
